contract.headline: Shin Yang wins RM316 million Home Ministry offshore patrol vessel contract
contract.summary: Accepted a letter of award from the Home Ministry to complete remaining works on OPV 2 (RM129.56m) and OPV 3 (RM186.44m) for the Malaysian Maritime Enforcement Agency, excluding sales tax. Commenced 15 Oct 2026 and runs 36 months to 14 Oct 2029.

contract.headline: SEB secures RM65.5 million data centre drainage and water tank subcontract
contract.summary: Letter of award from major shareholder MIE Industrial Sdn Bhd for Package 1 drainage and water tank works for a data centre in Negeri Sembilan. Expected 20 Nov 2026 to 30 Apr 2027 (5.5 months).
contract.caution: Counterparty is SEB's major shareholder (related party).

contract.headline: KJTS bags RM48 million mechanical works subcontract for Port Dickson data centre
contract.summary: Subcontract from Gamuda Engineering Sdn Bhd for mechanical works on a hyperscale data centre for a US-based tech multinational. Phase 1 completion 22 Oct 2027, Phase 2 on 21 Jan 2028.

positive.headline: Sunway Healthcare 3Q net profit jumps 59% to RM95.17 million
positive.summary: Net profit rose to RM95.17m from RM59.69m; revenue up to RM737.44m from RM593.13m on higher patient volumes and new hospitals. Nine-month net profit RM206.66m.

positive.headline: PetGas 3Q net profit rises to RM630.54 million, 18 sen dividend
positive.summary: Net profit RM630.54m vs RM444.23m a year earlier; revenue slightly lower at RM1.61bn. Third interim dividend of 18 sen, ex-date 9 Dec, payable 23 Dec 2026.

positive.headline: SunCon 3Q net profit up 25% to RM105.1 million, 7.9 sen dividend
positive.summary: Net profit up 25% to RM105.1m despite 26% lower revenue (RM1.07bn); order book at record RM12.45bn. Third interim dividend 7.9 sen, ex-date 9 Dec, payable 17 Dec 2026.

positive.headline: Sports Toto 1Q net profit rises 19.4% to RM26.4 million
positive.summary: Pre-tax profit up 3% to RM46.4m as H.R. Owen narrowed losses; revenue down 5.9% to RM1.41bn. First interim dividend 2 sen, ex 30 Dec, payable 15 Jan 2027.
